lines.en: : Um...thanks again for...walking all the way here with me, Sensei...
: I feel a little bad that...you didn’t even get to have a drink first...
: You can just make it up to me by giving me free beer for the next month. That seems fair to me.
: The price for...hanging out with you is pretty high...huh?
: Supply and demand, Sana. Supply and demand.
I’m surprised the two of us made it all the way up here without her giving the signal that it was time for me to leave.
Here I was, ready to tuck my hands into my pockets and rush over to the closest convenience store for a hot beverage, but-
Somehow or another, I’m outside of Sana’s dorm.
: Well there...sure is a lot of demand for you, so...I guess I understand...
: Can I...umm...ask you something, though?
: Is it another pricing question? Because I might need to have you call my secretary if it is.
: It’s not a...pricing question...
: I just wanted to ask if you could...keep all of that stuff about my mom a secret...
: Of course. It’s not like I’d come out and just tell someone, “Hey. Sana’s mom is in denial about the death of her son. Pass it on.”
: I’m more worried about you...saying something about it to her...
: And then what? Watch her break down in front of me and not know how to handle it?
: I’m by no means a good person, but it’s not like I’m evil, Sana.
: Then it...shouldn’t be an issue for you to promise me, right?
: I’ve compared you to a...dad a few times tonight, but...you aren’t family...
: So you shouldn’t really get involved...
: Are you saying you want to live in denial as well, then?
: I’m not denying anything...
: My big brother died and...part of me died with him.
: But the part that’s left needs to stay intact so...my mom can stay sane.
: Crazy to think that just the other day, your big breakthrough moment was confessing that you suddenly wanted to learn karate.
: H-Hey! Th-that was...probably even harder to come out and say than...all of this...
: It would be weird if...everyone I know kept getting closer to you and I stayed...
: On the inside of a triangle?
: That’s...actually a really good way of wording it...
: Thanks. I thought it up on the way over.
: Hah...all I kept thinking of was...how weird it felt walking around with you and...how tall you are...
: B-But...yes...
: I’m on the...inside of a triangle...
: And I...told myself that I’ll start being more honest with you...
: And what better place to do that than karate lessons?
: Stop bringing up karate lessons!
: And...and stop bringing up spaghetti!
: I didn’t even mention spaghetti.
: You were going to! You have the...spaghetti look in your eyes!
: Pfft...
: What am I...even saying right now?
It’s peculiar what jealousy can do to a person.
Between the Christmas party and now...and even before that, Sana and I never really had a dramatic shift in our dynamic.
She’s always just...been there being cute and...doing cute things, but-
We’re actually getting somewhere now.
Maybe I don’t just want to protect her? (And obviously have sex with her because...come on. I'm only human.)
But maybe I want to learn about her?
Maybe I want to watch her...try and fail?
To learn from her mistakes-
Maybe even succeed sometimes-
And to keep nervously smiling at me like I expect her to any moment now.
: Are you...um...
: Are you...cold?
Right on cue.
: Of course. It’s freezing out.
: Why do you ask?
: Well, you...walked the whole way here, so...
: If you want to...come warm up inside my room for a little while...
: That’s...that’s okay...
Holy crap, am I actually being invited in?
It’s way later than I’m usually here.
Is she really okay with this?
What has happened to my precious, reserved little Sana?
: You do realize how this sounds, right?
: I...have no idea what you’re talking about...
: But, um...Ayane isn’t home tonight and...it’s easier to talk about stuff when we’re...in a private room...
: Do you really not realize how this sounds?
: I told you...I...I have no idea what you’re talking about...
: I just...don’t really want you to go home yet...or something...
: When you say it like that, how could I possibly refuse?
: R...Really?
: I mean...I always knew you were going to say yes because...you’re a very...sketchy person...
: But it’s...still nice...actually hearing it.
: Okay, you’re still new to this, so I won’t be too harsh. But you don’t normally insult someone immediately after inviting them inside.
: Heheh...it wasn’t meant as an insult...
: I...like how unpredictable you are...
: It makes me...do things outside of my comfort zone...
: It’s...nice having someone like that again...
Sana opens the door and steps aside, lightly bowing to me and allowing me to walk in first.
Technically, I’m probably the one who should be doing that for her-
But since she offered, I’m obviously going to walk in.
Otherwise we’d just have two people standing around in the hallway and looking even more suspicious than we already were with our one-foot height gap.
: Oh, Sana! You’re home!
: I texted you and you didn’t respond, but I decided to-
: Stay home tonight...
: O-Oh! I’m...sorry...
: My...umm...my phone died on the way home...
: What are you doing here so late?
: And why are you two together?
: I walked Sana home from work.
: You walked...all the way from the bar with her?
: I did.
: You didn't just run into her on your way somewhere else?
: I...did not.
Sana nervously closes the door and takes a step toward Ayane with great hesitation.
: Um...Ayane...it was me who...asked him to t-take me home...
: And you invited him into the room as well?
: Y-Yeah...
: Even though it’s getting close to midnight and you knew I wasn’t going to be home?
: Well...it was cold out...so...
: I thought he could...warm up...
: Do you need to warm up, Sensei?
: You’ve been in my bed several times before, so you know how warm it can get when you hide under the covers.
: Ayane...
: No. Stay away from me. If you touch me, I will scream.
Okay, well, everyone here is clearly uncomfortable now.
Obviously, Ayane would be a bit confused seeing me walk into the room with Sana at this hour, especially since she was supposed to be away tonight.
Any rational person would come to the same conclusion.
And hell, Ayane isn’t even always rational and she’s seemed to reach that exact end-point.
: How was work?
: Did you have a good time?
: Seems like you closed early.
: Um...y...yeah...we did...
: Otherwise, Sensei wouldn’t have...
: Wouldn’t have what?
: She probably wants to say I wouldn’t have bothered walking home with her if it was any later.
: Is that true, though?
: No. I still would have walked with her.
: Of course you would.
: Because you’re kind and caring and compassionate and lovely and wonderful.
: And so is Sana.
: I...I know what it looks like...but that’s really...not what’s happening...
: I’ll probably believe that in the morning but, right now, I’m just trying to get some thoughts sorted out.
: It’s...definitely a little bit of a shock, though...hahahaha...
: I can’t even remember what I was about to say before you walked in.
: I’m not normally this forgetful.
: Sensei, pinch me and turn me back to normal.
: A-Ayane!
: Hm? What’s up?
: Can we maybe...talk out in the hallway for a minute?...
: The hallway? Why not just talk in here?
: Because it’s...something...I want to tell you and not...S...Sensei...
: But...what if it’s something I don’t want to hear?
: It’s something...I want you to hear...
: And...that should be enough...right?
: I...listen to things you tell me all the time and...I don’t ever...say anything bad about them...
: Yeah...I know...I just-
: Sensei...I’m sorry but...maybe it’s best if you...go home now...
: Yeah. I was just thinking about how warm I’ve suddenly become anyway.
: R...Right...
: And...um...I’m sorry that...you weren’t able to stay longer...
: I’m sure your legs are-
: My legs are fine. You’re underestimating just how much I walk around this god forsaken town.
: Goodnight, you two. Sorry for showing up unannounced, Ayane.
: What? Why are you apologizing to me? There’s no need to-
: Goodnight, Sensei...I’m...I’m sorry again...
I exit the room and quickly make my way out of the dorm.
It feels a lot colder than it did thirty minutes ago, but I guess things like that happen once your body temperature readjusts to the way things are indoors.
As I pass under streetlights, looking up at a suddenly cloudy sky, I think to myself about shapes.
About triangles, in particular.
And about how difficult it would be to escape if you were to ever find yourself trapped inside of one.
Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!
Meanwhile...
: Do you...want anything to drink?
: Why do we have to do this in the hallway?
: When my mom is feeling upset...I always offer to go for a walk with her...
: And you’re feeling upset, so...I’m just...doing the only thing I know how to do...
: You know that I’m...not good with people...so I’m sorry if this doesn’t...work with you...
: I’m not just “people” though, Sana. I’m Ayane.
: We live in the same room and even sleep in the same bed sometimes.
: You know everything about me, so...
: Why didn’t I know this about you?...
: Wh...what? I don’t understand...
: When did you...start feeling this way about Sensei?
: Wha-
: What way?!
: All...all we did was walk home together!
: That may be all you did but...was that all you wanted?
: I just...want to know how long you’ve felt like this for...
: But...I don’t feel like anything!
: I’m...I’m out here talking to you because I wanted to clear up any misunderstandings you had!
: What would you have done if Sensei tried to kiss you tonight?
: Run away and die!
: Sana...
: Your brain and your heart are disconnected...
: No! That’s not what’s happening!
: It is.
: It’s the same thing that happened to me.
: I just wish I would have found this out a lot less...suddenly.
: You’re...you’re wrong!
: I don’t even understand what you’re saying but I...I know it’s wrong!
: Is everything okay out here?
: It’s not every day that you hear Sana yell like that.
: What’s going on?
: It’s nothing, Maya...
: Sure as hell doesn’t sound like nothing.
: Okay. Well, it’s clear that this is something I shouldn’t be involved with, so I’m gonna go back to bed.
: Goodnight, Maya.
: Good...Goodnight...
: Yeah.
: Goodnight.
: Sana...
: I’ll...stop pestering you about it, but...
: I understand that it’s not possible to control how you feel about someone...
: I don’t feel that way about Sensei...
: I...can’t feel that way about him...
: Why?
: Because you’re afraid of hurting me?
: My mom likes him too, you know...
: Oh, stop. We both know Sensei isn’t into girls your mom’s age.
: We do?...
: That’s what I’m banking on, at least.
: But if you do feel that way about him-
: I don’t.
: Right. But if you do-
: Don’t worry about something like hurting me.
: I’ve been hurt plenty of times.
: Also, I’ve made it my life’s mission to never give up on him.
: So even if you somehow manage to defeat me, I’ll take him back by any means necessary.
: Unless you’re willing to share.
: Cause you know how cute I think you are and I probably wouldn't mind as long as it was a three-
: AYANE! STOP!!!!
